title: Draw Steel Featureblock
description: A titled collection of features under a loose-stat header: malice blocks, named feature blocks (e.g. Tactical Stance), and dynamic terrain. Unlike a statblock's fixed grid, featureblock stats are loose name/value pairs.

type.description: Routing type. Dynamic terrain is a featureblock at the schema level; it keeps its own SCC hierarchy.

kind.description: Featureblock flavor (omitted for dynamic terrain): a malice block or a named feature block.

level.description: Level qualifier ('Level 4+ Malice Features') or terrain level.

role.description: Combat role for terrain (e.g. Hexer, Ambusher); drives the semantic accent color.

terrain_type.description: Terrain classifier (Hazard, Trap, Trigger, Siege Engine, Relic, Fortification).

stats.description: Ordered loose header stats (e.g. EV / Stamina / Size). Values are free text ('1 per 10 x 10 thicket').

icon.description: Source emoji prefix; drives the action accent for table-less features.

formula.description: '+ 2' or '2d10 + R'; absent for a bare test result.

effects.description: SC-308 round 3b: the AUTHORITATIVE, ordered, non-lossy representation of the feature's body — an inline copy of feature.schema.json's effect shape (statblock.schema.json's features[] use the SAME shape, via its $ref to feature.schema.json; kept as its own copy here rather than a cross-file $ref, matching this repo's existing hand-synced-schema-copy convention). One entry per labeled/prose paragraph, carrying the tier table (roll/tier1..3) that attaches to it directly. The site renders THIS, in order — a named entry's tier panel nests inside its own section, no hoisting. power_roll/sections/enhancements/intro/body/trailing above are flat, unordered convenience copies of the same data, kept for existing consumers; a consumer that needs true render order reads `effects` instead of reconstructing it from them.

cost.description: Cost to trigger this entry (e.g. '3 Malice'); mutually exclusive with name.

roll.description: Power Roll expression ('Power Roll + 2' or '2d10 + R'); absent for a header-less tier list — the site derives its display label from this entry's own `effect` prose instead.

intro.description: Lead-in prose before the power roll/table (e.g. 'As a maneuver, … make a Might test.'); renders above the power roll.

trailing.description: Prose after the structured parts of an ability.
